title: Where and when the flow is prone to baroclinic instability
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity and velocity for 2011-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), estimate where and in which seasons the flow is most prone to baroclinic instability, for example from the vertical shear and the stratification, how the estimated growth rates and their location change from year to year, and how sensitive the estimate is to the depth range and to the measure used. Monthly means do not show the eddies themselves; state what can and cannot be concluded about them.
